source_of_truth: Operator pivot post-Plan 4 (architecture surface shipped at commit 5e27286) + post-Plan 3 (strict-plan-validate probe shipped at commit c104c22). Captured in this plan's D001-D002. Dogfood as product demonstration — run platform capabilities FROM DontPanic against our own repos and publish artifacts under docs/showcase/. Local integration deferred until concrete triggers fire.

user_journeys.name: new-user-sees-platform-on-real-repos
user_journeys.description: A new user lands on DontPanic's README, scrolls to 'See DontPanic on real repos', clicks into docs/showcase/README.md, and sees architecture HTML for DontPanic + agent-conventions + axiom + (SpinDine OR Glam) plus strict-plan-validation summaries + DontPanic's own drift status. They get the 'I can see what this does' moment in <60s without running any commands.
acceptance_signals: Repo README.md has a 'See DontPanic on real repos' section linking to docs/showcase/README.md
docs/showcase/README.md lists ≥4 target repos with artifact links
Each artifact entry includes its exact regen command (copy-pasteable)
agent-conventions specifically shows schema repo legibility (modules + schemas + validators + downstream consumers)
No leaked absolute paths visible in browsed HTML/JSON content

user_journeys.name: operator-regenerates-showcase
user_journeys.description: An operator runs `make showcase` (or `scripts/showcase.sh`) from the DontPanic checkout. The wrapper invokes `python -m dontpanic_orchestrate showcase regen --all`. For each configured target with an existing repo_root, the generator produces the artifact matrix (architecture always; validate-plans-strict for has_dontpanic_plans=True targets; drift for has_committed_architecture_json=True targets). Missing checkouts degrade gracefully. Redactor strips absolute paths BEFORE write. Sanitization scan blocks any leak.
acceptance_signals: `make showcase` and `scripts/showcase.sh` both work as one-line operator entry
Missing target_repo_root → 'target not found at <path>; skipping' + continue
Per-target supported_artifacts honored (no false-positive errors when validate-plans-strict isn't applicable)
Redactor raises RedactorError if `/Users/` substring survives in any artifact post-redaction
sanitization_check.py scans docs/showcase/ + passes on every committed artifact
No DontPanic runtime code copied into any target repo

user_journeys.name: agent-conventions-becomes-legible
user_journeys.description: A new user opens docs/showcase/agent-conventions-architecture.html and immediately understands the schema repo's shape — schemas + validators + Pydantic models + downstream consumers (DontPanic, Jarvis, Glam, SpinDine) all visible in one mobile-responsive page. The page renders cleanly in Chrome/Safari/Firefox on macOS + Linux. No absolute paths visible. The schema repo stops feeling abstract.
acceptance_signals: agent-conventions-architecture.html exists under docs/showcase/
Module graph SVG renders (architecture HTML inherits Plan 4 F002 visuals)
Schema list visible (schemas + Pydantic models from agent-conventions/schemas/v1.0/)
Mobile-responsive (single column <800px)
No `/Users/` absolute paths visible in rendered content

user_journeys.name: team-knows-when-to-promote-to-local-integration
user_journeys.description: A team member reads docs/showcase/README.md's 'Local integration — deferred' section. The section codifies three concrete triggers for promoting a repo from showcase-only to local integration: (a) target repo wants committed architecture.json for offline / contributor consumption; (b) target repo wants drift checks wired into its OWN CI; (c) target repo has active non-DontPanic contributors who need the map in-repo. The team member can evaluate whether any of those triggers has fired for their repo without re-litigating the decision.
acceptance_signals: docs/showcase/README.md has 'Local integration — deferred' section
Section explicitly lists the 3 concrete triggers from this plan's forbidden_decisions
Section explains why showcase-only is the v0 default (high blast radius of distributed runtime integration)
Section provides a path for proposing local integration when a trigger fires (link a follow-on plan template or operator-contact pattern)

non_goals: No subtree / vendor / copy of DontPanic runtime code into target repos in v0
No auto-regen in supervisor, pre-commit hooks, or CI — operator-explicit invocation only
No install report sample artifact (depends on Plan 2 F004)
No state projection sample artifact (depends on Plan 003 close-out + export)
No work-request / intake demo artifact (depends on Plan 4.5)
No targeting every owned repo simultaneously — v0 picks exactly 4 (DontPanic + agent-conventions + axiom + one of {SpinDine, Glam})
No agent-conventions remote dependency (Plan 5 — separate; showcase uses local checkout)
No embedding of showcase index page in any live external site (operator-controlled deployment)
No validate-plans-strict for repos that don't follow DontPanic-style plan dirs (config flags this via has_dontpanic_plans=False)
No drift artifact for repos without committed architecture.json (v0 = DontPanic only)

No local integration (committed architecture.json, target-repo CI drift, target-repo pre-commit hooks) until one of three triggers fires: (a) repo wants committed architecture.json for offline/contributor consumption, (b) repo wants drift checks in its OWN CI, (c) repo has active non-DontPanic contributors who need the map in-repo
No wall-clock-bounded sweep for showcase regen — operator-explicit, untimed (full architecture regen across 4 repos may take minutes; not a sweep budget item)
No leaked absolute paths or secrets in committed artifacts — sanitization scan blocks merges
completion_test: A new user lands on the DontPanic README, follows 'See DontPanic on real repos' into docs/showcase/README.md, and sees architecture HTML + JSON for DontPanic + agent-conventions + axiom + (SpinDine OR Glam) plus strict-plan-validation summaries (for the targets with plan dirs) plus DontPanic's own drift status — all with exact regen commands, no leaked absolute paths or secrets, and a clearly-codified 'Local integration — deferred' section listing the three concrete triggers that would justify a follow-on plan to subtree the architecture module into a target repo.
